notes: Technical report on scaling the Muon optimizer (arXiv 2502.16982), not a system card. No safety, alignment, refusal, jailbreak, bias, toxicity, privacy, honesty, hallucination, or dangerous-capability section, tables, or claims. All evalResults left empty per pilot safety-only rule. Skipped capability benchmarks: MMLU, MMLU-pro, BBH, TriviaQA, HumanEval, MBPP, GSM8K, MATH, CMath, C-Eval, CMMLU (Tables 4–7, 10; Figures 1b and 8). SVD entropy of weight matrices (Figure 4) is optimizer dynamics, not model interpretability/safety. Pretraining data details deferred to K. Team 2025. contextWindow is pretraining max length only.
